notes.why_16khz: Required by YAMNet. Human hearing covers 20-20kHz, Nyquist says 16kHz captures up to 8kHz which includes all crash-relevant frequencies
notes.why_64_mels: Standard for MobileNet-based audio models. More bins = more compute for marginal gain
notes.why_1sec_window: Crashes last 50-300ms. 1s window captures the full event with pre/post context
notes.target_device: Raspberry Pi 4 (ARM Cortex-A72, 2GB RAM, no GPU)
